**Decision:** Plan approval

# Implementation Plan

**Route:** quick_implementation (selected by user)

## Summary

Add a renderer-only, persisted dark/light theme system with shared accessible controls, Tailwind v4 light variants, and light styling for every non-media UI state while preserving dark media surfaces and native Electron chrome behavior.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Theme preference logic defaults to dark for missing or invalid stored values and writes valid selections as a non-expiring raw localStorage value.
- [ ] With no saved preference, the rendered join, loading, error, and meeting interface initially uses the existing dark theme.
- [ ] A sun/moon icon button with a descriptive accessible label and title tooltip is in the top-right header on both join and meeting screens.
- [ ] Settings is renamed from Device Settings, includes an Appearance section near its top, and its selector and both header toggles immediately show and apply the same selected theme.
- [ ] The selected light or dark theme remains active after restarting the renderer until the user changes it or clears renderer app data.
- [ ] Light mode uses white and light-slate interface surfaces with AA-readable text, controls, status states, borders, and visible keyboard focus across join, meeting sidebar, Settings, loading, error, transcript, summary, and STT-status states while retaining blue-violet accents.
- [ ] Video tiles, camera preview, and media overlays including their floating controls remain dark when light mode is selected.
- [ ] Theme changes use a brief color-only transition that is suppressed or reduced for prefers-reduced-motion users.
- [ ] Theme selection changes only renderer content and does not alter Electron's OS-managed native window chrome.

## Tasks

### 1. theme-preference-utility-tests

Create a small renderer theme-preference utility that validates dark/light values, falls back to dark, and reads/writes a direct non-expiring localStorage entry; add Node tests using a fake storage implementation for missing, invalid, valid, and persisted values.

**Files:** frontend/src/utils/themePreference.js, frontend/test/themePreference.test.js

**Verification:**
- Run `npm --prefix frontend test -- test/themePreference.test.js` and confirm default fallback and raw persisted-value cases pass.

### 2. app-theme-foundation-and-meeting-header

Integrate the validated preference into App-level state with an idempotent pre-paint document theme update, persist changes through the new utility, and pass the controlled theme value/change handler to join and Settings paths. Add a reusable Sun/Moon header icon button with title, aria-label, and visible focus styling; use it in the meeting header. Add Tailwind v4 light variant, dark-default/light root tokens, color-only theme transition rules, reduced-motion overrides, and robust global keyboard-focus rules in the imported stylesheet. Apply light variants to App-owned loading/error branches, meeting shell/header, sidebar tabs, benchmark panels, and controls without touching Electron window options.

**Files:** frontend/src/App.jsx, frontend/src/index.css, frontend/src/components/ThemeToggle.jsx

**Depends on:** 1. theme-preference-utility-tests

**Verification:**
- Run `npx eslint src/App.jsx src/components/ThemeToggle.jsx` from `frontend/`.
- In Electron, clear the theme storage key and verify dark first render; switch the meeting-header control, restart the app, and verify the selected renderer theme is restored while native chrome is unchanged.
- Enable reduced-motion in the OS/browser and verify theme color changes do not animate noticeably.

### 3. join-and-settings-light-appearance

Thread the controlled theme props through JoinScreen and both SettingsModal entry points. Add the reusable quick toggle beside the join-header status pill. Rename the modal heading to Settings, insert a labeled Appearance section before device controls with a synchronized dark/light selector, and add light variants plus AA-safe accent/text/focus treatments for join cards, forms, recent-room states, modal surfaces, every form field/select, status cards, configuration sections, and modal actions. Preserve the preview stage, its permission error overlay, and preview controls as dark media UI.

**Files:** frontend/src/components/JoinScreen.jsx, frontend/src/components/SettingsModal.jsx

**Depends on:** 2. app-theme-foundation-and-meeting-header

**Verification:**
- Run `npx eslint src/components/JoinScreen.jsx src/components/SettingsModal.jsx` from `frontend/`.
- Manually switch themes from the join header and Settings Appearance selector, confirming immediate synchronization, keyboard-visible focus, readable selected values, and a tooltip/accessible name on the header button.
- Use a contrast checker on light-mode normal text, labels, buttons, inputs, and blue/violet/semantic status text; verify AA contrast and retain the dark camera-preview region.

### 4. meeting-panel-light-states-and-dark-media

Add light variants and AA-safe semantic/accent colors to transcript, summary (including markdown and empty/configuration states), and STT download/status panels. Add visible focus treatment to the floating media control buttons while keeping their dark overlay palette, and explicitly retain VideoView tile, nameplate, camera-off, and media-overlay dark classes with no light-surface override.

**Files:** frontend/src/components/CaptionPanel.jsx, frontend/src/components/SummaryPanel.jsx, frontend/src/components/SttStatusBar.jsx, frontend/src/components/MeetingControls.jsx, frontend/src/components/VideoView.jsx

**Depends on:** 2. app-theme-foundation-and-meeting-header

**Verification:**
- Run `npx eslint src/components/CaptionPanel.jsx src/components/SummaryPanel.jsx src/components/SttStatusBar.jsx src/components/MeetingControls.jsx src/components/VideoView.jsx` from `frontend/`.
- In light mode, exercise transcript empty/history/error states, summary setup/generated/action/question states, and STT idle/download states; verify light surfaces, readable controls, and visible keyboard focus.
- Verify active video, camera-off tiles, nameplates, preview, and floating media controls stay dark in light mode.
- Run `npm --prefix frontend test`, `npm --prefix frontend run lint`, and `npm --prefix frontend run build`.

## Assumptions

- A native select is an acceptable Appearance selector in Settings when it is labeled, keyboard accessible, and controlled by the same App-level theme state as the header buttons.
- The browser-provided title attribute satisfies the requested tooltip for the compact header icon button.
- Raw renderer localStorage is available in the Electron renderer profile and persists until renderer app data is cleared.

## Risks

- The UI has many hard-coded dark utility classes; each affected text, border, surface, hover, disabled, and semantic status pairing must receive a deliberate light variant or it can fail contrast on a light surface.
- A global theme-transition rule must be limited to color-related properties so it does not interfere with existing video, layout, or hover transform transitions; reduced-motion overrides must take precedence.
- Existing Node tests do not render JSX components, so interactive synchronization, all visual state branches, contrast, and Electron chrome isolation require manual Electron verification in addition to the new persistence unit tests.

exploration.architecture: React 19 + Tailwind CSS v4.1.18 (CSS-first: `@import "tailwindcss"` in frontend/src/index.css, no tailwind.config.js, no @theme/custom variants) renderer built by Vite 7 and loaded via Electron file:// (base './'). main.jsx imports only index.css (App.css is dead boilerplate, unimported). App.jsx is the root state machine: startupError -> error screen, !runtimeConfig||!socket -> loading screen, !meetingId -> JoinScreen, else meeting screen (header + VideoView grid + sidebar with Summary/Transcript/Bench tabs + SettingsModal). All theming is hard-coded dark Tailwind utilities inline (`bg-white/[0.0x]` overlays, `bg-slate-950` surfaces, `text-slate-500/300`, `border-white/10`, `text-white`); blue-violet accent palette (#0E71EB brand, blue-500->violet-500 gradients, blue-400/300 accent text). Theme persistence belongs in App.jsx's localStorage `storage` util (currently 24h expiry — theme must bypass it). SettingsModal heading is 'Device Settings' (line 57) and must become 'Settings' with a new Appearance section near the top (before Camera). Quick sun/moon toggle goes top-right: JoinScreen header right side currently holds only the 'Audio local' pill (line 211-212); App meeting header right side holds STT pill, E2EE pill, and sidebar toggle (lines ~737-749). Media stays dark: VideoView tiles use bg-slate-950/bg-black/45, JoinScreen camera stage is bg-slate-950 with bg-black/40 controls. Native chrome is already OS-managed (desktop/main.js createWindow sets no backgroundColor).
conventions: All styling is inline Tailwind utility classes; arbitrary values like bg-white/[0.04], text-[10px], size-11 are the norm; no CSS modules or styled-components
Uppercase micro-labels: `text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest` in slate-500/gray-500 (dark theme)
SettingsModal section headers: icon-in-tinted-box (e.g. `w-8 h-8 bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400`) + `text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-400`
Components exported with React.memo; App.jsx uses 2-space indent, components use 4-space; no formatter configured, follow surrounding file
Existing visible-focus pattern in SummaryPanel: `focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-blue-400`; JoinScreen inputs use `focus:ring-2 focus:border-blue-400/70`
Persistence via App.jsx localStorage `storage` wrapper with expiry for config (stt_config, llm_config, recent_rooms); user-facing prefs stored in renderer localStorage (Electron userData profile)
React.StrictMode is enabled in main.jsx, so theme-state initializers must be idempotent
similarImplementations: frontend/src/App.jsx lines 59-84: `storage` localStorage wrapper — template for no-expiry theme persistence key
frontend/src/components/SummaryPanel.jsx lines 117/212/221/230/264/294: existing focus-visible outline convention to replicate on new theme controls
frontend/src/components/SettingsModal.jsx lines 61-104: Device section layout — Appearance section should mirror this structure near the top
risks: Large diff: every visible element across App.jsx, JoinScreen, SettingsModal, MeetingControls, CaptionPanel, SummaryPanel, SttStatusBar uses hard-coded dark utilities; a `light:` custom variant (@custom-variant in index.css) is the cleanest Tailwind v4 mechanism but requires touching most JSX class strings

WCAG AA in light mode: existing accent text tones (blue-200/300, violet-200/300, purple-300, emerald-300, amber-200) fail contrast on white/light-slate; they must be darkened (blue-600/700, violet-600/700, purple-600/700) only in light mode

index.css line ~318 globally sets `input:focus, select:focus, button:focus { outline: none; }`; light-mode controls need deliberate focus indicators (ring/border/outline) since native outlines are removed
Theme persistence must NOT use the existing `storage` util (24h expiry would forget the theme); use a raw localStorage key so it lasts until app data is cleared
`animate-in zoom-in-95` on SettingsModal container (line 51) is a no-op class — tailwindcss-animate plugin is not configured and v4 does not ship it; don't rely on it for theme transitions
Loading/error screens in App.jsx use hard-coded `bg-[#0a0a0a]` (lines ~700-712) and must be included in light coverage per acceptance criteria
Theme toggle must be reachable before runtimeConfig loads? No — loading/error screens render early returns, so the toggle only needs to exist on join + meeting screens per spec

No frontend component/App tests exist (test/ has only captions.test.js and llmModels.test.js covering utils/config), so no test updates are required, but `npm --prefix frontend test` still runs and must pass
knownLessons: AGENTS.md: preserve `base: './'` in frontend/vite.config.js (Electron file:// renderer needs relative asset URLs)
AGENTS.md: run frontend checks from root via `npm --prefix frontend test` / `npm --prefix frontend run lint`; `npx eslint <path>` from frontend/ for focused lint
AGENTS.md: keep Electron capabilities behind the preload bridge; theme is purely renderer-side (localStorage) so no preload/IPC changes are needed
AGENTS.md: no formatter configured; follow the surrounding file's style

evidence.detail: Lines 59-84: localStorage `storage` wrapper with 24h expiry for stt_config/llm_config/recent_rooms; theme must use a separate no-expiry localStorage key
Lines 700-712: startupError screen and loading screen both hard-code `bg-[#0a0a0a] text-white` (error + loading states need light coverage)

Line 714: meeting `<header className="min-h-16 bg-slate-950/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10 ... justify-between">`; right side (lines ~737-749) holds STT pill, E2EE pill, sidebar toggle button — quick theme toggle goes here top-right

Lines 1014-1021: SettingsModal rendered from showSettings state; props passed include sttConfig/llmConfig setters — theme + toggle props must be threaded to JoinScreen (line ~677-699) and SettingsModal

Line 201: join screen header `flex h-14 items-center justify-between border-b border-white/10 bg-slate-950/55`; line 211-212 right side is the 'Audio local' pill — quick theme toggle goes in this header top-right

plan.summary: Add a renderer-only, persisted dark/light theme system with shared accessible controls, Tailwind v4 light variants, and light styling for every non-media UI state while preserving dark media surfaces and native Electron chrome behavior.
assumptions: A native select is an acceptable Appearance selector in Settings when it is labeled, keyboard accessible, and controlled by the same App-level theme state as the header buttons.
The browser-provided title attribute satisfies the requested tooltip for the compact header icon button.
Raw renderer localStorage is available in the Electron renderer profile and persists until renderer app data is cleared.
acceptanceCriteria: Theme preference logic defaults to dark for missing or invalid stored values and writes valid selections as a non-expiring raw localStorage value.
With no saved preference, the rendered join, loading, error, and meeting interface initially uses the existing dark theme.
A sun/moon icon button with a descriptive accessible label and title tooltip is in the top-right header on both join and meeting screens.
Settings is renamed from Device Settings, includes an Appearance section near its top, and its selector and both header toggles immediately show and apply the same selected theme.
The selected light or dark theme remains active after restarting the renderer until the user changes it or clears renderer app data.

Light mode uses white and light-slate interface surfaces with AA-readable text, controls, status states, borders, and visible keyboard focus across join, meeting sidebar, Settings, loading, error, transcript, summary, and STT-status states while retaining blue-violet accents.
Video tiles, camera preview, and media overlays including their floating controls remain dark when light mode is selected.
Theme changes use a brief color-only transition that is suppressed or reduced for prefers-reduced-motion users.
Theme selection changes only renderer content and does not alter Electron's OS-managed native window chrome.

Add a reusable Sun/Moon header icon button with title, aria-label, and visible focus styling; use it in the meeting header. Add Tailwind v4 light variant, dark-default/light root tokens, color-only theme transition rules, reduced-motion overrides, and robust global keyboard-focus rules in the imported stylesheet. Apply light variants to App-owned loading/error branches, meeting shell/header, sidebar tabs, benchmark panels, and controls without touching Electron window options.
verification: Run `npx eslint src/App.jsx src/components/ThemeToggle.jsx` from `frontend/`.

In Electron, clear the theme storage key and verify dark first render; switch the meeting-header control, restart the app, and verify the selected renderer theme is restored while native chrome is unchanged.
Enable reduced-motion in the OS/browser and verify theme color changes do not animate noticeably.

tasks.description: Thread the controlled theme props through JoinScreen and both SettingsModal entry points. Add the reusable quick toggle beside the join-header status pill. Rename the modal heading to Settings, insert a labeled Appearance section before device controls with a synchronized dark/light selector, and add light variants plus AA-safe accent/text/focus treatments for join cards, forms, recent-room states, modal surfaces, every form field/select, status cards, configuration sections, and modal actions. Preserve the preview stage, its permission error overlay, and preview controls as dark media UI.
verification: Run `npx eslint src/components/JoinScreen.jsx src/components/SettingsModal.jsx` from `frontend/`.

Manually switch themes from the join header and Settings Appearance selector, confirming immediate synchronization, keyboard-visible focus, readable selected values, and a tooltip/accessible name on the header button.
Use a contrast checker on light-mode normal text, labels, buttons, inputs, and blue/violet/semantic status text; verify AA contrast and retain the dark camera-preview region.

tasks.description: Add light variants and AA-safe semantic/accent colors to transcript, summary (including markdown and empty/configuration states), and STT download/status panels. Add visible focus treatment to the floating media control buttons while keeping their dark overlay palette, and explicitly retain VideoView tile, nameplate, camera-off, and media-overlay dark classes with no light-surface override.
verification: Run `npx eslint src/components/CaptionPanel.jsx src/components/SummaryPanel.jsx src/components/SttStatusBar.jsx src/components/MeetingControls.jsx src/components/VideoView.jsx` from `frontend/`.

In light mode, exercise transcript empty/history/error states, summary setup/generated/action/question states, and STT idle/download states; verify light surfaces, readable controls, and visible keyboard focus.
Verify active video, camera-off tiles, nameplates, preview, and floating media controls stay dark in light mode.
Run `npm --prefix frontend test`, `npm --prefix frontend run lint`, and `npm --prefix frontend run build`.

risks: The UI has many hard-coded dark utility classes; each affected text, border, surface, hover, disabled, and semantic status pairing must receive a deliberate light variant or it can fail contrast on a light surface.
